maddeler.e:
تزدردون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِدُونَ (tazdaridūna) /taz.da.ri.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# تُزْدَرَدُونَ (tuzdaradūna) /tuz.da.ra.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
